parameters.command:
bash -s <<'N8N_MAINTENANCE'
set -euo pipefail
[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || { echo 'Root access required' >&2; exit 1; }
exec 9>/var/lock/n8n-weekly-apt.lock
flock -n 9 || { echo 'Another weekly update is running' >&2; exit 1; }
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=a
apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update
apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=600 -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold upgrade -y
if [ -f /var/run/reboot-required ]; then
  printf '\nN8N_REBOOT_REQUIRED=1\n'
else
  printf '\nN8N_REBOOT_REQUIRED=0\n'
fi
N8N_MAINTENANCE
